$comment: The factory's only switchboard. Change values here — never fork a doc.

$markets.purpose: Which store ecosystems a game targets. Drives store specs, billing SDK, listing rules, localisation and cultural design.
$markets.howToChange: Say which market(s) to cover, e.g. 'target the Iran market' or 'both'. The agent sets this field and reads only the matching markets/<name>.md.
$markets.modules: markets/<name>.md — one file per market, all following markets/_TEMPLATE.md

languages.$comment: Primary UI language. Market modules may require others (Iran ⇒ fa). Never assume a language from the market alone — check the module.

$readingOrder: AGENTS.md — start here: how to run the factory
factory.json — this file: what to build for
markets/<selected>.md — the only place store facts live
GAME_BLUEPRINT.md — what every game must ship (market-agnostic)
LESSONS.md — binding rules from real failures
